Watch the classic Hindi song "Itna Hai Tumse Pyar Mujhe" from the superhit Bollywood classic romantic drama old Hindi movie Suraj (1966) starring Rajendra Kumar, Vyjayanthimala, Johnny Walker & Mumtaz. Directed by T. Prakash Rao & Produced by S. Krishnamurthy. Music by Shankar Jaikishan. This song is sung by Mohammed Rafi and Suman Kalyanpur.
